notes: Fixes the remaining null-valued-expression failure in multi-wrap Batch Split. The problem was in the per-cover WinForms event handlers: they depended on local variables that could disappear after each cover panel was created, so paint/drag/save events could later see null state. Each cover panel now stores its own persistent state directly on its controls, and all paint, guide-drag, save, and remove handlers read from that persistent state instead. The v1.0.10 safe image loader and v1.0.9 temporary full-wrap behavior are preserved. Windows PowerShell parsing, synthetic current-source patching, full panel creation, visible-form paint-event processing, and payload/hash validation passed before publish.
